# Copper Wren Movement Studio: 2029 Tuition and Hire Guide

Term Three tuition is due on 16 July 2029.
The second sibling receives 12 percent off term tuition, excluding equipment hire and travel.
A Term Three withdrawal received by 17:00 on 2 July 2029 qualifies for a full tuition refund.
After 2 July 2029, any refund request needs teacher review and no amount is guaranteed.
The equipment hire bond is $42 and is returned only when the kit reaches the office within five calendar days after the final show, clean and undamaged.
The $42 equipment hire bond does not pay for a trial class.
This guide cannot show whether an individual invoice has been paid.
A bursary application does not extend the tuition payment deadline.
The annual administration fee is $21 per student and receives no sibling discount.
A term tuition invoice can be paid in two instalments only after the office approves a plan.
